Source supports it (agents.md span exact, work page says the same). Documented and default are defensible, but the data an agent can read exists only after a person connects the tool, so one could argue for available on the Notion, Drive and Calendar part. The span itself (files shared in the room, with the asking person's own access) is in the room regardless of connection, which supports default.
